setup: QA user alice (role marketing) in the built-in browser against the dev stack; dashboard of 3 pages with 17, 17 and 16 chart widgets over 5 charts, seeded by backend/scripts/seed_native_perf_dashboard.py and removed afterwards

attempt_1.finding: Switching pages every 1.5 s produced 53 query requests: 3 answered, 42 refused with 429, 8 aborted; an earlier rapid-switching run produced about 9,400 requests. Cause: switching pages aborted queries already sent; the browser freed their slot at once while the server kept running them, so the next page exceeded the server's 4 concurrent dataset queries and retried.
attempt_1.fix: A query that was sent is no longer aborted (charts, table totals, filter options); only queries still waiting in the page queue are dropped. Test: frontend/src/features/native-dataviz/dashboard/model.test.ts 'lets a chart request that was sent finish when its chart goes away' (fails on the old code).

memory.trend: none; garbage-collection sawtooth between 138 and 218 MB

limits: Measured in a shared desktop browser pane on the development host; usedJSHeapSize is Chromium's sampled heap without forced garbage collection.
